title: Slope Calculator
description: Get the slope, y-intercept and equation y = mx + b through two points, with a small graph.
howto: Read the slope, intercept, equation and see the plotted line.

faqs.a: Rise over run — how many y units the line climbs for each x unit. Positive slopes rise left to right.

faqs.q: Why is slope undefined for vertical lines?
faqs.a: Run is zero (x₂−x₁ = 0), and division by zero is undefined. The line is simply x = constant.
Plug one point into y = mx + b and solve: b = y₁ − m·x₁.
